relationships.subject: ACC PV+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: ACC PV+ neurons bidirectionally regulate pain and social preference, but do not mediate social novelty processing

relationships.subject: ACC SST+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibition of this neuronal population is sufficient to rescue pain-induced social novelty deficits

relationships.subject: ACC GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: ACC GABAergic neurons exert bidirectional and dissociable control over pain and social behavior

relationships.subject: CFA
relationships.evidence_quote: CFA injection resulted in a marked increase in c-Fos expression within CaMKII⁺ neurons 2 days after treatment

relationships.subject: CFA
relationships.evidence_quote: a significant reduction in extracellular GABA levels (Figure 3K) following CFA injection

key_findings: ACC GABAergic activation relieves pain but fails to rescue social deficits, whereas GABAergic inhibition rescues social deficits.
PV+ neurons regulate pain and social preference while SST+ neurons selectively mediate social novelty deficits; VIP+ neurons have no role.
